prompts.home:
Use case: ui-mockup, scoped visual simplification of an established mobile anniversary app.
Create realistic production-quality mobile UI, ONE full standalone screen, logical390x844, render1170x2532 or exact same portrait ratio. No device bezel, notch, OS status bar, browser chrome, home indicator, rounded device mask or presentation canvas. The attached EXISTING screen is functional/image reference but its big headings, descriptions, rounded surfaces and decorative styles are ANTI-REFERENCE and MUST be removed.

USER'S LATEST DESIGN SYSTEM IS STRICT:
- NO top PAGE TITLE or brand bar; no top "相册", "数据", "拾日", or redundant "纪念日" page heading. Bottom tabs identify the page.
- No descriptive text, slogans, helper paragraphs, instructions, explanatory subtitles, repeated local-storage banners or marketing copy. Retain ONLY functional selectors/action names, dates, quantities, and essential status labels.
- PURE WHITE #FFFFFF surface. Primary text #141414, secondary #6B6B70. ONE solid blue-violet #5146E5 for actual actions and selected controls, pressed#4338CA. No gradient of any kind, especially no purple-pink decorative lines.
- NO CARDS, NO nested containers, NO bordered panels, no background boxes. Use alignment, intentional whitespace and occasional fine neutral #E7E7EB separators. No shadows anywhere.
- ALL photo thumbnails have EXACT SQUARE CORNERS (radius0), no borders, no shadows or container. Buttons have near-square corners radius4 logical px MAX, never pills. List rows have radius0 and no container.
- One modern system sans serif family (Chinese PingFang SC/Noto Sans CJK SC, system numeric sans), no serifs/calligraphy, body/actions17 logical, group labels17 semibold, dates/counts13, navigation12. Avoid thick black display headings. Countdown only may be96pt light.
- Page gutters20logical, spacing4/8/12/16/24/32, main sectiongap32, photo gridgaps2. Minimum visible controls44logical high. Content can breathe; do NOT invent new text or cards to fill empty space.
- Bottom nav fixed, 3 equal items 纪念日 / 相册 / 数据, same consistent thin outline calendar/photo-stack/layers icons. Selected icon+label near-black, others neutralgray. Plain white background, hairline top divider, no rounded dock or capsule.
- Keep all actual product constraints: local-only originals and metadata, no accounts/cloud/social. Original demo currentdate2026-11-13, firstdate2022-11-20, elapsed1454days, next2026-11-20 in7days.
Any extra reference images are structural research inspiration ONLY: Apple Photos date/photo hierarchy, not its floating pill controls; Google historical promotional photo grouping, not its giant rounded frames. NEVER copy device frames, brand logos, promotional text, actual other-app faces, colors, or rounded styling.
The result must look like a disciplined photo-first utility with flat native lists and strong whitespace, not a card dashboard. All content is precise, legible, unclipped.
SCREEN: ANNIVERSARY HOME, 纪念日 selected.
Preserve SAME daylight seaside couple cover and the 3 memory photo identities from supplied home screenshot. Full-bleed cover touches top edge and occupies approximately upper54% of screen, without rounded masking.
REMOVE the large "在一起 · 四周年" heading. Instead, inside the photo left clear sky area, use ONLY a small17px FUNCTIONAL EVENT SELECTOR "在一起" with tiny chevron, inset20 at y≈72logical. Under this, a clean light-weight sans "7" at96logical and smaller"天后". Date row "2026.11.20 · 四周年" in13logical. No colored line or decoration below.
Near-black overlay type on this bright photo, chosen for local contrast. This system switches to white on dark photos, but do not add a toggle or explanatory text.
Below image, a compact white line "已过 1,454 天" left and "2022.11.20 起" right, no cards or big statistic block. Next white section has modest17px label "回忆胶片" left and tappable "48张 ›" right. Below it a single THREE-COLUMN strip of straight-corner photos:2025 seaside chairs,2024 strawberry cake,2023 cafe coffee. Years13px below each. Absolutely zero rounding.
REMOVE the big filled "查看回忆" button; tapping the photo strip or48张 enters the same gallery. REMOVE "本机保存" and "备份与互传" repeated rows; those functions remain in bottomnav. Do NOT replace removed elements with additional features. Use calm whitespace before bottom nav. Total composition remains coherent and photo-forward.
Allowed visible text ONLY: 在一起 / 7 / 天后 / 2026.11.20 · 四周年 / 已过1,454天 / 2022.11.20起 / 回忆胶片 / 48张 /2025/2024/2023/纪念日/相册/数据.

No top title at all. First line directly shows "3个纪念日 · 126张照片" in17px nearblack. Nearby aligned smaller13px gray "486 MB" conveys current local storage. No label "本机资料", no icon card, no dramatic huge486 metric.
